title: Only real fans get past stage three | FAN LIFE Trivia
description:
How well do you really know your club? Trivia on FAN LIFE, shown with Olympiacos: Every club on FAN LIFE has its own trivia wing, written from that club's own history. Not a generic quiz. Your club. Twelve questions in three stages, and every stage is harder than the last. You get three lives, and a wrong answer costs one. Answer quickly and the combo grows, up to four times. The clock is part of the game, so thinking fast is how you score big. Four levels, from easy to expert. Every answer is checked against the club's archive, and every question shows its source.

▶ Play it: https://fanlife.dubelteam.com/clubs/olympiacos/trivia

Narration is synthetic. #FANLIFE #FootballGames #FootballFans
